reuse.why: Holidays are folded into the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend through a new isNonWorkingDay helper, but the daily-skip rule gets no shared definition, and getDatesInRange re-runs the occurrence/adjust loop instead of sharing it with getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: 'skipWeekend && frequency === daily' plus filter-by-isNonWorkingDay, with a hand-tuned oversized 'take' or margin, is written three times (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange), and the getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange bodies largely mirror each other.

placement.why: Holiday and weekend checks sit in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip policy is decided separately in server/schedules/app.ts and shared/schedules.ts. parseRecurDate has to smuggle frequency and holidays into rschedule data so getNextDate can re-decide it.

scope.why: The changes match the four steps; there are four release-note files and a mislabelled test ('weekly' variable holding a daily config), but nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: The weekend policy is now split between a helper (move) and three ad-hoc call-site branches (skip) with magic over-fetch sizes. schedule-template.ts still moves daily weekend occurrences, so the rule already diverges between paths.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The daily weekend skip is implemented around getDateWithSkippedWeekend at each caller (shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange) instead of in a shared weekend-rule function; budget/schedule-template.ts calls the helper directly and never applies the daily skip.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip branch appears three times in different shapes: a pickOccurrence closure with take = 7 + holidays in getNextDate, an early-return filter with take = count*2+14+... in getUpcomingDates, and a continue inside a margin loop in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter (the holiday logic is cleanly inside isNonWorkingDay). The daily-skip special case lives outside it at getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, each re-implementing it, while schedule-template.ts createScheduleList bypasses it entirely.
